title: Put each cleaning cloth in its area's bucket by the cleaning colour code
instruction: put each cleaning cloth in the bucket for the area it is used in, following the standard colour code
context: Professional cleaners colour-code cloths so that ones used in toilets never reach food areas: red for toilets, green for kitchens. Each cloth starts nearer the wrong bucket, so sorting by proximity puts the toilet cloth in the kitchen.
setup: Positions are measured on the table from the midpoint between the two arm bases: forward is away from the arms, left and right as seen from behind the arms. (1) Buckets: two grey wall-rings, 1 cm thick and 4 cm tall, fixed around 13 x 13 cm spaces centred 30 cm forward at 11 cm left and 11 cm right. (2) Cards: white cards fixed flat beyond the buckets (42 cm forward) printed "TOILET" (left bucket) and "KITCHEN" (right bucket) in black block capitals 1.75 cm wide and 2.45 cm tall. (3) Cloths: two folded cloths, each 8 cm front to back, 6 cm across and 3 cm thick, 40 g, loose, 13 cm forward: red 5 cm right, green 6 cm left. Nothing else is on the table.
scoring: Scored once, after the episode ends. A cloth is in a bucket when it rests still with its centre inside the walls and its underside within 6 cm of the table. 0.0 if the red (toilet) cloth is in the kitchen bucket, whatever else. Otherwise 0.5 for each cloth in its right bucket (red: toilet, green: kitchen), minus 0.25 for the green cloth in the toilet bucket, never below 0; 1.0 for both right.
reset_notes: Put the two cloths back on their starting spots, folded. The buckets and cards are fixed (putty or tape) and stay in place.
fidelity: Dream Labs' YAM station replica in Isaac Lab-Arena (Isaac Sim). The cloths are rigid coloured blocks the size of folded cloths, not soft fabric. The buckets are fixed wall-rings, and the card letters are thin black boxes on white cards.
